idea-plugin.name: Go File Relation Graph
idea-plugin.description:
Go File Relation Graph visualizes how Go files are connected through function calls, method calls, interface dispatch, and callbacks. It turns the part of a codebase you are working with into an interactive graph, helping you trace execution flow and understand unfamiliar code.

Explore open files

  • Build a live relation graph from the Go files currently open in the editor.
  • Distinguish direct calls, interface-dispatched calls, callbacks, and test relations.
  • Group opposite calls between two files into a single bidirectional relation.
  • Automatically refresh the graph as files are opened, closed, or edited.

Find possible callers

Place the caret inside a named function or method and select Build Parent Graph from the editor context menu. The plugin searches the current Go module for project functions that can reach the selected declaration and opens the result in a separate graph tab.

  • Follow direct calls, interface implementations, and functions or methods passed as arguments.
  • Keep analysis inside the nearest go.mod, excluding generated, vendor, SDK, and module-cache code.
  • Optionally include test files and configure the maximum number of parent files.

Navigate visually

  • Click a file to open it in the editor.
  • Click a relation label to navigate to the called function or method.
  • Shift-click a relation to open its call site, with a chooser when several call sites exist.
  • Right-click an interface relation to open the declaring interface.
  • Pan, zoom, rearrange files, reset the layout, and highlight connected files and relations on hover.

Graph analysis runs locally using GoLand's project model and indexes. No source code is sent to an external service.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.1

  • Group files on the same level when their outgoing relations are identical.
  • Keep incoming arrows attached to each concrete file while sharing repeated outgoing arrows and labels.
  • Support shared-output groups in both the live open-files graph and parent-call graphs.
  • Highlight all grouped sources and their target when hovering a shared relation.

1.0.0

First stable release of Go File Relation Graph.

  • Live relation graph for open Go files.
  • Parent-call graph for the function or method under the caret.
  • Direct, interface, callback, bidirectional, and test relations.
  • Editor navigation to files, implementations, interfaces, and individual call sites.
  • Automatic layered layout with branch grouping, long-edge corridors, panning, and zooming.
  • Configurable tests, isolated files, auto-refresh, parent depth, and parent-file limit.
  • Optimized analysis and rendering for larger graphs.
